parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs) as total_audit_logs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') as old_audit_logs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats) as total_exec_stats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as old_exec_stats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rate_limits WHERE window_start < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as expired_rate_limits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_health WHERE checked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as old_health_checks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keyword_rankings WHERE checked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '365 days') as old_rankings, (SELECT pg_database_size('greevo')) as db_size_bytes

SELECT log_audit(NULL, 'audit-cleanup', 'data_cleanup_completed', 'system', NULL, '{{ JSON.stringify({rows_cleaned: $node["Plan Cleanup"].json.total_rows_to_clean, db_size_before_mb: $node["Plan Cleanup"].json.db_size_mb, tasks: $node["Plan Cleanup"].json.cleanup_tasks.length}) }}'::jsonb, 'success')
